system_architecture.description: CSF shunt with passive safety floor: a secondary drainage path with lower conductance that maintains minimum drainage when the primary path obstructs. Differential pressure thresholds activate the floor path.

subsystems.name: Primary drainage lumen
subsystems.function: Primary CSF drainage path with higher conductance G_primary

subsystems.name: Secondary (safety floor) lumen
subsystems.function: Lower-conductance path that opens when primary obstructs (pressure threshold or mechanical backup)

subsystems.name: Pressure-activated switch (optional)
subsystems.function: Mechanical switch that activates floor path when primary path dP exceeds threshold

key_equations: Q = (pi * r^4 * dP) / (8 * eta * L) [laminar flow, circular conduit]
hydraulic_model.critical_parameter: G_floor / G_primary ratio — sets drainage floor fraction when primary is patent; sets minimum drainage when primary obstructs

safety_invariants.INV-1: Q_floor >= Q_min when primary obstructs (minimum drainage floor)
safety_invariants.INV-2: Q_total <= Q_max when primary patent (prevents over-drainage)

design_outputs.description: Multi-lumen catheter geometry (primary + floor lumen diameters, length, layout)

engineering_build_plan.equipment: Obstruction simulator, flow sensors, pressure transducers

engineering_build_plan.acceptance_criterion: No occlusion at specified bend radius

mechanism_architecture.physical_changes: When primary lumen obstructs (debris, tissue ingrowth, protein aggregation), pressure upstream rises; secondary lumen either passively continues to drain (always open, lower conductance) or opens via pressure-activated switch.
mechanism_architecture.key_physics: Parallel hydraulic conductance: G_total = G_primary + G_floor. When G_primary -> 0 (obstruction), G_total -> G_floor. Floor conductance sized to maintain minimum drainage Q_min = G_floor * dP.

activation_model.model: Two-mode operation: (1) normal: G_primary >> G_floor, primary dominates; (2) obstructed: G_primary -> 0, floor dominates
activation_model.transition_mechanism: Either always-open floor (passive) OR pressure-threshold-activated floor (semi-active)

engineering_content.technology_domain: Hydraulic Passive Safety + Multi-Lumen Valve Mechanics

governing_model.summary: Parallel hydraulic conductance model. Two drainage paths in parallel: primary (high conductance) and floor (lower conductance). When primary obstructs, floor maintains minimum drainage.
equations: Q = (pi * r^4 * dP) / (8 * eta * L) [P-07 multi-lumen floor conductance — laminar flow per lumen]
G_total = G_primary + G_floor [parallel conductance] [P-07 parallel floor conductance — passive safety floor mechanism]
Q_floor_min = G_floor * dP_max [minimum drainage at worst-case pressure]
assumptions: Outlet pressure identical for both paths
Floor path is immune to the same obstruction mechanism (CRITICAL ASSUMPTION — may not hold)
parameter_sensitivities: G_floor / G_primary ratio — determines drainage distribution
Floor lumen diameter d_floor (scales as d^4 per Hagen-Poiseuille)
Obstruction mode of primary — must NOT affect floor
failure_regimes: Floor lumen obstructs by same mechanism as primary (common-cause failure)
G_floor too high -> over-drainage when primary patent
G_floor too low -> under-drainage when primary obstructed
Floor lumen too small -> manufacturing tolerance dominates

critical_parameters.name: G_floor (floor conductance)
critical_parameters.basis: Design choice balancing Q_min vs over-drainage

critical_parameters.name: Floor lumen diameter d_floor
critical_parameters.basis: Derived from G_floor target via Hagen-Poiseuille

engineering_core.external_precedent: EXTERNAL_PRECEDENT ≠ INVENTION_VALIDATION — existing CSF shunts (Codman Hakim, Medtronic Strata, Miethke proGAV) establish that fixed-pressure and programmable valves are manufacturable. None implement a true passive drainage floor with parallel lumen. The proposed mechanism is distinct from existing anti-siphon or gravitational devices.

proposed_design.transformation: ICP -> (Q_primary + Q_floor) depending on obstruction state
proposed_design.component_architecture: Multi-lumen extruded catheter -> inlet (ventricular) -> primary lumen + floor lumen -> outlet (peritoneal)
